reporting-org.narrative: Norad - Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation

description.narrative:
Syria Community Consortium for building resilience in Syria. The consortium operates across five pathways of change, each led by different member organizations (DRC, NRC, IMC UK, and Oxfam).
Pathway of Change/Objective 1 – Food Security and Climate-Sensitive Production: Crisis-affected households and communities have increased food production for consumption and/or income by using climate-sensitive agriculture practices. Pathway of Change/Objective 2 - Household Income & Financial Services: Crisis-affected households and communities generate sustainable and sufficient income from employment or self-employment to improve economic well-being Pathway of Change/Objective 3 - Functioning Markets: Markets utilized by crisis-affected communities are functional, inclusive, and accessible Pathway of Change/Objective 4 - Basic Services: Crisis-affected households and communities benefit from affordable, appropriate, accessible, equitable and high-quality basic services Pathway of Change/Objective 5 - Enabling Community Environment: Crisis-affected communities are more cohesive, inclusive, safe, and equitable
The program will be addressing the specific needs of women across relevant pathways and data will be disaggregated by gender. The program will also promote inclusive decision-making and governance at the community level.
